decisive_spans.text: Rapid diagnostic testing (Abbot BinaxNOW): positive for T1 (histidine-rich protein 2) and T2 (aldolase) antigens

response.rationale: The rapid diagnostic test results, specifically positive for T1 (histidine-rich protein 2) and T2 (aldolase) antigens, are highly indicative of Plasmodium falciparum malaria. T1 (HRP2) is specific to P. falciparum, while T2 (aldolase) indicates a Plasmodium species. The presence of both strongly supports P. falciparum. Candidate D9 (Malaria) is too general, and D5 (Plasmodium ovale malaria) is contradicted by the specific antigen findings.
